title.ja: 四時十七分の木柱と、消えた石壁
title.en: The Wooden Post of Four-Seventeen and the Vanished Wall

quote.ja: この文字の彫り癖、肉筆のストローク、および字形の傾きを鑑定した結果、元同僚書記ミルテの筆跡と完全に一致した（確認）。
quote.en: Upon examining the carving habits, stroke tension, and slant of the characters, I found them to be an exact match to the handwriting of my former colleague, Myrte (Confirmed).

mood.ja: 事実と筆跡の冷たい符合に、胸の奥が微かに軋む。
mood.en: A cold alignment of facts and handwriting causes a faint ache deep in my chest.
